Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Thank you for
joining us at the Jamestown Concert Hall. I am pleased to
introduce Jin-Ho Shin, who is giving his first piano concert
here in Jamestown tonight. Mr. Shin's career is interesting
because he's traveled almost nonstop for the past several
years. In the last year alone, he has performed in over 60
cities in 20 different countries. Before he takes the stage,
l'd like to remind you to turn off your mobile phones to
prevent interruptions during the performance.
